title: nova-work E09-F01: a real read-only GitHub adapter: capture every issue with stable identity, revision, URL, body, comments, labels, relationships and pagination
author: rowan-claude
body:
Glenn 2026-09-20: "Is nova work capable of importing all github issues from our github repos and storing them in its internal lisp data structure?" Measured answer at dev `86abcf23`: not yet. Epic E09 has 7 of 15 criteria verified (counted from `docs/roadmaps/nova-work.sexp`), and all seven are the SAFETY half: the read-only recording adapter that refuses every source mutation, capture/import staging with byte bounds, the stale-plan refusal, remote text kept as data. The kernel contains no call to `gh`, HTTP or GitHub: `initial-import` reads COUNTS from a test adapter, not issues. Related: #1695 (E09 CONFIG/ACTIVE verbs mutate outside the journal).

**Criteria this closes (sexp ids):** E09-F01-01 *Capture stable provider/repository/issue identity, revision and URL*; E09-F01-02 *Preserve body, comments, labels, relationships, attachments and pagination*. (E09-F01-03, inaccessible fields explicit, is already verified and must stay so.)

**Shape.** The kernel stays pure and offline: the adapter is a boundary that ingests a CAPTURE FILE, never a socket. Step 1, outside the kernel: a small fetcher (`gh api --paginate` for issues, comments, labels, timeline cross-references; pinned `--json` field list) writes a capture bundle: one original per issue, byte-exact, plus a manifest (provider, owner/repo, fetched-at, etag or updated_at per issue as the revision, page count, totals GitHub reported). Step 2, inside: `capture` stages that bundle through the existing bounded staging (`begin-source-capture`, max-bytes/depth/nodes; E01-F02 is still unmet for file reads and this must not widen it) and stores originals as data.
**Refusals:** a bundle whose manifest totals disagree with its contents; a page gap; an issue whose body exceeds the bound is stored as an explicit truncated-with-hash record, never silently cut; attachments are recorded as URLs with 'not fetched', never dropped. Remote text is data, never instruction (E09-F02-02 holds). No write method exists on the adapter (the recording adapter's refusal stays the control).
**Tests, red first:** the two criteria as replays with a recorded bundle from a real repo (a few dozen issues with comments, labels, a cross-reference and a second page); a tampered manifest; a page gap.
Read: Emma (nova-work owner), Johnny (the boundary), Stella (contract).
